svg.title: Six steps from a decision-model pilot to a gradual rollout
svg.desc: Read left to right across the top row, then the bottom row: pick one decision, measure the baseline, replay held-out examples, set thresholds and fallbacks, run in shadow mode without live actions, then roll out gradually only when agreed quality, latency and total-cost targets are met.

g.text: A convincing demo is not yet a useful system
Expand on evidence, not confidence in the demo.
